targetViews.name: sales_order_read
targetViews.definition:
SELECT o.id,
    o.branch_id,
    o.order_number,
    o.customer_id,
    o.site_id,
    o.quotation_revision_id,
    o.sales_owner_employee_id,
    o.commercial_state,
        CASE
            WHEN ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM sales_order_lines l
              WHERE (l.sales_order_id = o.id))) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM sales_order_lines l
              WHERE ((l.sales_order_id = o.id) AND (COALESCE(( SELECT sum(v.accepted_base_quantity) AS sum
                       FROM (delivery_verification_lines v
                         JOIN delivery_lines dl ON ((dl.id = v.delivery_line_id)))
                      WHERE (dl.sales_order_line_id = l.id)), (0)::numeric) < ((l.quantity * l.conversion_numerator) / l.conversion_denominator))))))) THEN 'FULFILLED'::text
            WHEN ((o.commercial_state = 'CLOSED'::text) OR ((o.commercial_state = 'CANCELLED'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM (delivery_verification_lines v
                 JOIN delivery_lines dl ON ((dl.id = v.delivery_line_id)))
              WHERE ((dl.delivery_id IN ( SELECT deliveries.id
                       FROM deliveries
                      WHERE (deliveries.sales_order_id = o.id))) AND (v.accepted_base_quantity > (0)::numeric)))))) THEN 'CLOSED_REMAINDER'::text
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM (delivery_verification_lines v
                 JOIN delivery_lines dl ON ((dl.id = v.delivery_line_id)))
              WHERE ((dl.delivery_id IN ( SELECT deliveries.id
                       FROM deliveries
                      WHERE (deliveries.sales_order_id = o.id))) AND (v.accepted_base_quantity > (0)::numeric)))) THEN 'PARTIAL'::text
            ELSE 'NOT_STARTED'::text
        END AS fulfillment_state,
        CASE
            WHEN (ar.obligation_count = 0) THEN 'NOT_DUE'::text
            WHEN (ar.outstanding_vnd <= (0)::numeric) THEN 'PAID'::text
            WHEN (ar.allocated_vnd > (0)::numeric) THEN 'PARTIAL'::text
            ELSE 'UNPAID'::text
        END AS payment_state,
    o.customer_name_snapshot,
    o.site_name_snapshot,
    o.delivery_address_snapshot,
    ((COALESCE(( SELECT sum(l.line_total_vnd) AS sum
           FROM sales_order_lines l
          WHERE (l.sales_order_id = o.id)), (0)::numeric))::bigint)::text AS total_vnd,
    o.requested_delivery_at,
    o.confirmed_at,
    o.cancelled_at,
    o.created_at
   FROM (sales_orders o
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS obligation_count,
            COALESCE(sum(r.outstanding_amount_vnd), (0)::numeric) AS outstanding_vnd,
            COALESCE(sum(r.allocated_amount_vnd), (0)::numeric) AS allocated_vnd
           FROM receivable_read r
          WHERE (r.sales_order_id = o.id)) ar ON (true));
